validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: real, not a GEM-only entity. neftegaz.ru's 2019 incident report names 'газопровод-подключение Мастах - Берге' as one of 3 named components of the wider ГТС СВГКМ-Мастах-Берге-Якутск; Rostekhnadzor's press service via Interfax-Russia (2023-03-03, name_found confirmed via url_verifier --name) explicitly enumerates 'Участке магистрального газопровода СВГКМ-Мастах-Берге-Якутск (I, II, и III нитки)' -- threads I/II/III as distinct physical strings under one regulatory designation. DUPLICATE CHECK (per this batch's explicit scope-brief instruction: 'confirm each string's own year and diameter rather than assuming' for the P3364/P6691 pair): directly resolved this run by visually inspecting Sakhatransneftegaz's own internal commissioning-year table (embedded image at ipng.ysn.ru, https://ipng.ysn.ru/wp-content/uploads/2021/03/12.jpg -- I viewed this image directly, not merely via a sibling shard's note). The table lists 'МГ Мастах-Берге, 1 нитка' (P3364, thread I) as ONE row: 184.00 km / 1973, versus thread II (this row, P6691) as FOUR SEPARATE phased rows: 59.00 km/1984, 36.30 km/1986, 51.80 km/1987, 36.70 km/1988. These sum to exactly 183.80 km, matching P6691's recorded LengthKnown to the hundredths place. This is conclusive: P3364 and P6691 are genuinely distinct physical strings with entirely different, independently documented construction histories (single 1973 build vs. four-phase 1984-1988 build) -- not a duplicate pair, and not a case of one string's data being carried onto the other. CLASSIFICATION CAVEAT: neftegaz.ru's system breakdown labels the Mastakh-Berge component a 'газопровод-подключение' (connector/connection pipeline), narrower than the 'МГП' (магистральный газопровод, trunk pipeline) label it reserves for Taas-Tumus-Yakutsk specifically; however Rostekhnadzor, the actual safety regulator, classifies the whole corridor including this segment as 'магистральный газопровод' under one safety-oversight designation, and the segment is long-haul, high-pressure, cross-district infrastructure functionally indistinguishable from trunk/transmission pipe. GEM's PipelineType=transmission is kept as correct.

validity.researcher_notes: neftegaz.ru/194257: 'Проектная производительность 2-х ниток - 4,2 млн м3/сутки, максимальная - 6,3 млн м3/сутки, 3-й нитки - около 8 млн м3/сутки.' The preceding sentence in the same article uses an explicit 'каждая' (each) qualifier for length ('Протяженность - 460 км каждая из 2-х'), which the capacity sentence lacks, weakly favoring a COMBINED reading -- but a combined-then-halved per-thread figure (~2.1 million m3/day, ~0.77 bcm/y) sits far below the recorded value and produces an implausible capacity-vs-diameter jump to the newer 720mm 3rd thread's ~8 million m3/day (2.1-to-8 vs a physically smoother 4.2-to-8 step for a 530mm-to-720mm diameter increase). On balance the per-thread reading is favored, at medium confidence. energybase.ru's structured database entry independently states 'Мощность 1.50 млрд. м³/год' for the whole Kysyl-Syr-Mastakh-Berge-Yakutsk corridor (system-wide, not thread-specific) -- read directly, text present verbatim ('1.50 млрд. м3/год') though url_verifier's plain substring check reports a false FAIL (likely a non-breaking-space/decimal-mark artifact in the served HTML); this is weak secondary corroboration of the NUMBER but, being a system aggregate itself, does not resolve the per-thread-vs-combined ambiguity.
